rubrics.justification: Morphology description is broadly consistent with the provided 3AA label, but it appears to lean heavily on the known Gardner score and includes some potentially fabricated image-specific details (e.g., exact ICM location, mild heterogeneity, partial out-of-focus assessment) that may not be clearly verifiable from the image alone.
Strong integration of age, DOR/AMH, FSH, BMI, endometrium, sperm parameters, first-cycle status, and lifestyle factors with embryo quality and prognosis.

Overall reasoning is logical and well structured, with age-related aneuploidy appropriately emphasized; minor issues include somewhat arbitrary percentage modifiers and a few speculative links such as stress/diet effects.

Mostly aligned with IVF practice in discussing morphology, age-related aneuploidy, and protocol considerations, but some recommendations are less guideline-based or overly assertive (e.g., aspirin, acupuncture, DHEA/CoQ10 dosing, strong critique of long agonist protocol in this specific successful cycle).
Provides clear practical steps for transfer technique, luteal support, counseling, and future cycle planning, though some suggestions are more adjunctive/speculative than standard-of-care.
